title: 第一卷 第117章 百货商场是非多！
slug: 重生1989我一赌鬼带全家顿顿吃肉
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

县里的晚上可比镇上热闹多了。

即便是到晚上十点，都还有不少摆摊的。

他们出来的早，如今也不过才六点多，但那些小吃摊就已经有不少人了。

“南枝，玲儿，你们今天想吃什么？”

王建军刚说完，便看见玲儿伸手指着一个地方，眼神都在发光。

王建军顺着看了过去，不由得笑了笑。

自家闺女真是越来越会吃了，一眼便看上了那边卖鸡腿的。

“好，那咱们先去买三个鸡腿，一人一个，然后拿着鸡腿去吃三鲜米线！”

王建军说着，让玲儿骑在了他的脖子上。

玲儿似乎很喜欢这种坐得高高的游戏，高兴的伸着手，看的李南枝在后面都不由得跟着笑了起来。

但还是一直跟着他们，生怕玲儿掉下来。

“建军，你慢点，别把玲儿摔了。”

他们一家三口在那排着队，说着今天一天发生的事情。

大多都是李南枝在说医院的事，王建军则认真的听着。

晚上不比白天那么热，时不时还有几阵微风吹过。

王建军觉得，如今的他比上辈子成为百万富翁时还要幸福。

毕竟他穷其一生所追求的幸福，也不外乎就是这个样子了。

李南枝说了半天，见王建军只是笑着看着她，不免有些脸红，自己也不好意思了。

“不说了，我一天到晚都说这些家长里短的事，你是不是听着也怪无聊的。”

“怪我，你都在外面忙了一天了，我不该拿这种琐事来烦你。”

李南枝说着，低下了头，还有几分愧疚。

她现在在家里也挣不了钱，更不能帮王建军分担什么。

但王建军现在越来越好，越来越能挣钱，就连在县里都能买上房子了，这让李南枝不免觉得自己都有些配不上他了。

就在这时，李南枝突然察觉到自己的小手被人牵住了。

抬头一看，便发现王建军不知道什么时候把玲儿又重新抱在了怀里，腾出了一只手来拉着她。

“说什么呢？关于你的事情，就是说的再多，我都不会烦，我巴不得让你多说一点呢。”

“今天晚上咱们一个房间睡，你再多说点好不好？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The county is much more lively at night than the town.

Even at ten o'clock in the evening, there were still many stalls set up.

They came out early, and it was only after six o'clock, but there were already many people at the food stalls.

"Nanzhi, Ling'er, what do you want to eat today?"

As soon as Wang Jianjun finished speaking, he saw Ling'er pointing at a place with her eyes shining.

Wang Jianjun looked over and couldn't help but smile.

My daughter is getting better and better at eating, and she immediately fell in love with the chicken drumstick seller there.

"Okay, let's buy three chicken legs first, one for each person, and then take the chicken legs to eat three fresh rice noodles!"

Wang Jianjun said, letting Ling'er ride on his neck.

Ling'er seemed to like this kind of sitting-high game very much. She stretched out her hands happily, and Li Nanzhi couldn't help but laugh behind her.

But he still followed them, for fear that Ling'er would fall.

"Jianjun, please slow down, don't drop Ling'er."

The three of them were lining up there, talking about what happened today.

Most of the time, Li Nanzhi was talking about the hospital, while Wang Jianjun listened carefully.

The night is not as hot as the day, and there are a few breezes blowing from time to time.

Wang Jianjun feels that he is happier now than when he became a millionaire in his previous life.

After all, the happiness he has spent his whole life pursuing is nothing more than this.

Li Nanzhi talked for a long time, but when she saw Wang Jianjun just looking at her with a smile, she couldn't help but blush a little, and she felt embarrassed.

"Stop talking about it. I talk about these trivial matters all day long. It sounds boring to you."

"It's my fault. You've been busy outside all day. I shouldn't bother you with such trivial matters."

Li Nanzhi said, lowering his head, still feeling a little guilty.

She can't make any money at home now, let alone share anything with Wang Jianjun.

But Wang Jianjun is getting better and better now, making more and more money, and can even buy a house in the county. This makes Li Nanzhi feel that she is not worthy of him.

At this moment, Li Nanzhi suddenly realized that his little hand was being held by someone.

Looking up, he found that Wang Jianjun had held Ling'er in his arms again at some point and freed up one hand to hold her.

"What are you talking about? No matter how much I talk about you, I won't be annoyed. I wish you could talk more."

"Let's sleep in the same room tonight. Can you tell me more?"
